3. UG seats and 24 PG seats medical college along with hostels for
4. students, faculty & staff accommodation with other necessary, allied
5. and associated infrastructure) and Future Development (i.e. Nursing
6. College with Hostel facilities, Para Medical Clinic and Training
7. Centre, Dental College, Telemedicine Centre, Physiotherapy Centre,
8. Health and Medical Wellness Centre, Aayush / Ayurveda Centers,
9. any health and medical related facility or increase the number of

11. College as per the NMC norms) as per terms of the DCA. No non-
12. clinical and commercial development is permitted to be developed
13. on the Project Site.
15. C. The Concessionaire has flexibility to plan and design the site
16. keeping in view optimum utilization of land, fulfilling all building
17. bye-laws, regulations and guidelines including NMC norms.
18. However, the site plan must include the present constructed area.
20. # 2. Transfer of human resource of existing hospital and cost
21. thereof
23. A. The Government of Andhra Pradesh will provide only salary for
24. the medical and non-medical staff, transferred with the existing
25. hospital, for two years from the 'Effective Date'. The existing list of
26. staff to be transferred is appended.
28. B. The staff available on the 'Effective Date' shall be transferred
29. to the Concessionaire with existing hospital and will report to the
30. Concessionaire. The list of such staff available at present is
31. provided. The availability of such staff may vary based on the
32. willingness of the staff at the time of handover of the existing
33. hospital to the Concessionaire on Effective Date.
35. C. The Concessionaire is required to assess the provision of
36. additional staff (medical, non- medical, para medical etc) needed as
37. per NMC norms for hospital and medical college and bear the Cost
38. of provision of such additional staff. The Government of Andhra
39. Pradesh will not provide any operation and maintenance grant or
40. bear any expense thereof for running and operation of hospital and
41. medical college.
43. # 3. Future Development
45. A. The Concessionaire is permitted to carry out additional
46. development as part of future development. The Concessionaire
47. with the permission of the Authority, may develop components
48. including Nursing College with Hostel facilities, Para Medical Clinic
49. and Training Centre, Dental College, Telemedicine Centre,
50. Physiotherapy Centre, Health and Medical Wellness Centre, Aayush

## GOVERNMENT OF ANDHRA PRADESH
ABSTRACT

HM&FW Department - APMSIDC - Modifications to the RFPs and Draft
Concession Agreements for four medical colleges (Adoni, Markapuram,
Madanapalli, Pulivendula) under PPP mode in Phase-I - Orders - Issued.

HEALTH, MEDICAL AND FAMILY WELFARE (H2) DEPARTMENT

G.O.RT.No. 847

Dated: 02-12-2025
Read the following:

1. G.O.Rt.No.590, HM&FW(H2) Department, Dated:09.09.2025.
2. G.O.Rt.No.197, HM&FW (H2) Department, dated:11.04.2025.
3. Proposal from the MD, APMSIDC, A.P., Mangalagiri, Guntur
District, e-file bearing Computer No.2865475.

*****

## ORDER:-

In the G.O. 1st read above, Government have issued orders for
development of 10 new medical colleges at Adoni, Madanapalli,
Markapuram, Pulivendula, Penugonda, Palakollu, Amalapuram,
Narsipatnam, Bapatla and Parvathipuram under PPP mode; and approved
the draft RFPs and Concession Agreements for the development of four
(4) medical colleges at Adoni, Markapur, Madanapalli, and Pulivendula
under PPP mode under Phase-I. The remaining six (6) medical colleges
will be taken up immediately after finalization of the Feasibility Reports,
Draft RFPs and Concession Agreements. The Tender Committee was
permitted to make minor modifications to the RFPs based on pre-bid
consultations.

2. In the reference 3ʳᵈ read above, the MD, APMSIDC has informed
that two pre-bid consultations held on 06.10.2025 and 23.10.2025. The
PPP Committee constituted vide G.O. 2ⁿᵈ read above, has been met on
13.11.2025 and discussed in detail about the responses to be given to the
pre-bid queries received. The PPP Committee have discussed deliberately
and drafted the responses against each of queries. The Committee have
opined that the following issues requires approval of the Government
before publishing the same in e-procurement platform:

## 1.Allocation of Land for each project

1. A. The total tentative land to be leased for each site is as below:
2. i. Adoni - 49.64 acre
3. ii. Madanapalli - 52.47 acre
4. iii. Markapuram - 47.10 acre
5. iv. Pulivendula - 48.50 acre

The site Plans for each site are appended.
